def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Cubic bivariate polynomial to compute log10(|ID|/A)."""
    a0 = parameters[0]
    a1 = parameters[1]
    a2 = parameters[2]
    a3 = parameters[3]
    a4 = parameters[4]
    a5 = parameters[5]
    a6 = parameters[6]
    a7 = parameters[7]
    a8 = parameters[8]
    a9 = parameters[9]
    a10 = parameters[10]
    a11 = parameters[11]
    
    coefficient0 = a0 + a1 * gate_voltage_abs + a2 * drain_voltage_abs + a3 * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs
    coefficient1 = a4 + a5 * gate_voltage_abs + a6 * drain_voltage_abs + a7 * gate_voltage_abs * drain_voltage_abs
    coefficient2 = a8 + a9 * gate_voltage_abs + a10 * drain_voltage_abs
    
    return np.log10(coefficient0 + coefficient1 * gate_voltage_abs + coefficient2 * drain_voltage_abs)
